stories.headline: Magnificent 7 loses $1 trillion as Nasdaq plunges 5.5% on AI data-center fears
stories.summary: The S&P 500 fell -4.36% to 7,353.73, the Dow -3.44% to 51,523.06, and the Nasdaq -5.52% to 24,315.00 — each index's worst day since April 2025 — as AI-linked tech led a broad rout that erased Wednesday's midterm rally.

stories.headline: BNSF reports train derailment near Plymouth, Washington, closing main track
stories.summary: BNSF said it received a preliminary report about 9:13 a.m. CDT on Nov. 4 of a derailment near Plymouth, Wash., about 29 miles southwest of Pasco, that has affected the main track; no reopening estimate was given.

stories.headline: After midterm sweep, Democrats map a Congress agenda centered on Iran war and oversight
stories.summary: With control of both chambers secured, Democrats are preparing war-powers votes, appropriations leverage and investigations aimed at ending the Iran conflict and scrutinizing the Trump administration once the new Congress convenes.

stories.headline: Douglas County voters reject $54 million school mill levy override
stories.summary: Unofficial results show Measure 5A failing about 55% to 45%, leaving Douglas County School District facing a projected $15–18 million budget gap as Superintendent Erin Kane says cuts will still be needed.

stories.headline: Najera's overtime brace lifts No. 5 MSU women's soccer past Washington 3-2
stories.summary: Bella Najera scored in the 96th minute off a corner rebound to send Michigan State into the Big Ten Tournament semifinals, where the Spartans will face Michigan on Sunday in St. Louis.

breadth.label: Percent of S&P 500 stocks above 50-day MA
breadth.note: Below 30 bullish, above 70 bearish. Computed by Thaddeus from Yahoo Finance daily closes for 501 of 503 current S&P 500 constituents at the Nov. 5 close (mimics MMFI). Breadth fell hard as Thursday's AI-led sell-off pulled hundreds of names back under their 50-day averages.

fear_greed.commentary: Fear & Greed sank to 20 (extreme fear) after Thursday's close, essentially flat with the prior close of 20 and down from 26 a week ago and 47 a month ago, matching the AI-led crash that wiped out Wednesday's midterm rally.

markets.summary: Wall Street erased Wednesday's midterm relief rally in its worst session since the April 2025 tariff shock: the S&P 500 plunged -4.36% to 7,353.73, the Dow -3.44% to 51,523.06, and the Nasdaq -5.52% to 24,315.00, putting the Nasdaq into correction territory as AI and chip names led all 11 S&P sectors lower. Tech bore the brunt — NVDA fell -9.26% to $181.60 (now -2.63% YTD and below its 40-week average), SPCX dropped -9.05% to $123.62, and the Nasdaq's RSI slipped to 30.1 with MACD deeply negative — while small caps joined the rout, the Russell 2000 down -4.45% to 2,729.89 and also below its 40-week average. Rates eased as investors fled equities, with the 10-year yield at 4.84% (-1.16% on the day, -3.05% on the week). Gold futures (GC=F) slipped -1.5% to $4,051.6 after a stronger midweek bounce and remain below their 40-week average (-6.67% YTD), while silver futures fell -1.61% to $51.39 and are still deeply underwater for the year (-26.73% YTD).

stories.headline: Tesla and SpaceX lose over $420 billion in combined market cap after midterms
stories.summary: SPCX fell about 9% to $123.62 as investors priced tougher Democratic scrutiny of Musk, Texas data-center moratorium risk under Gov.-elect Gina Hinojosa, and a harder path for any SpaceX–Tesla merger; combined with Tesla's drop, Musk's firms have shed more than $420 billion since Tuesday's close.

stories.headline: SpaceX stock falls as Goldman and Apollo test demand for $40B AI chip debt
stories.summary: Shares also came under pressure after reports that Goldman Sachs and Apollo are shopping slices of SpaceX's roughly $40 billion off-balance-sheet Nvidia-chip financing, with SpaceX credit-default swaps near a record ~282–284 bps.

stories.headline: Cameco hits a new 52-week low as post-earnings pressure persists
stories.summary: CCJ traded as low as $68.17 and closed near $68.33 (-4.67% on the day), extending losses after the late-October Q3 miss, lower uranium sales volumes, and a narrowed 2026 production outlook tied to Key Lake maintenance.

stories.headline: Cameco renews US$1 billion at-the-market equity program
stories.summary: Cameco filed to renew its ATM program, allowing issuance of up to US$1 billion of common shares through Dec. 5, 2029 for development, acquisitions, debt repayment or general corporate purposes, replacing the November 2024 facility.

stories.headline: Nvidia slides 9.26% as AI chip sell-off and midterm uncertainty hit
stories.summary: NVDA closed at $181.60 on heavy volume (~300M shares) with no company-specific catalyst, as traders rotated out of AI/chip names ahead of the Nov. 17 earnings report and fretted that Democratic wins could slow data-center buildouts.

stories.headline: Magnificent 7 loses $1 trillion; Nvidia alone sheds more than $440 billion
stories.summary: Nvidia led the Mag7's more-than-$1 trillion market-cap wipeout Thursday, turning negative year to date as the Nasdaq posted its worst day since April 4, 2025 and the VIX logged its biggest point gain since that tariff shock.

headlines.headline: Nasdaq plunges more than 5%, Dow drops 1,800 points, wiping out post-election gains
headlines.summary: Chip stocks sank hard (SOXX −12%, AMD −17%, NVDA −9%) on worries Democratic control of Congress and key statehouses could slow AI data-center permitting, while SpaceX and Tesla each fell about 9–11% on Musk regulatory risk.

headlines.headline: Tesla and SpaceX lose over $420 billion after Democrats sweep Congress and Texas
headlines.summary: Musk's companies extended post-election losses as investors priced Texas data-center moratorium risk, potential congressional probes, and a tougher path for any SpaceX–Tesla merger under Democratic majorities.

stories.headline: Children's Hospital Colorado opens Orthopedic and Sports Medicine Center in Highlands Ranch
stories.summary: Children's Colorado opened a one-stop pediatric ortho and sports medicine center in Highlands Ranch, consolidating clinics formerly at Centennial and South Campus and adding a sports performance program with gym, court and field space.

stories.headline: Iran watches midterm fallout as Trump links election losses to the war
stories.summary: Tehran is weighing the risk of further U.S. strikes even as President Trump has publicly tied Republican losses to the Iran war's hit on gasoline prices and living costs.

stories.headline: Bank of England lifts rates to 4%, first hike in more than three years
stories.summary: The MPC raised Bank Rate from 3.75% to 4% (8–1) to lean against energy-driven inflation from the US-Iran war, with Governor Andrew Bailey warning another rise is likely unless the Middle East conflict is resolved.

stories.headline: Melania Trump hosts Russian and Ukrainian officials after Oleshky ceasefire
stories.summary: At a White House meeting Thursday, the first lady urged both sides to turn a six-day local truce that evacuated nearly 800 people from Oleshky into a more enduring peace, as new U.S.-brokered talks are eyed for Abu Dhabi next week.

stories.headline: No. 6 MSU men's basketball rolls past Toledo 91-61 at Breslin
stories.summary: Freshman Jasiah Jervis scored 16 points and four Spartans reached double figures as Michigan State improved to 2-0 with a 30-point home win; next up is No. 2 Duke in the Champions Classic.

stories.headline: MSU visits Michigan for Paul Bunyan Trophy on Saturday night
stories.summary: The Spartans (2-6, 0-5 Big Ten) play at Michigan Stadium on Saturday at 7:40 p.m. ET on Peacock, chasing the Paul Bunyan Trophy after a bye week following a 28-10 loss at UCLA.

stories.headline: After Seeing Election Results, Trump Announces Retaliatory Tariffs On America
stories.summary: The Babylon Bee says President Trump slapped retaliatory tariffs on the United States itself after Republicans' midterm losses.

stories.headline: Democrats Grateful They No Longer Have To Pretend To Be Normal
stories.summary: With midterms over, the Bee reports Democrats nationwide felt relieved they no longer had to keep pretending to be normal.

stories.headline: Study Finds Human Brain Capable Of Storing Up To 40 Things
stories.summary: The Onion reports breakthrough research claiming the human brain can store as many as 40 things, upending notions of cognitive capacity.

weather.summary: A slow-moving East Coast front brings rain from the Northeast to the Southeast through Saturday, with a Slight Risk of excessive rainfall and Flood Watches over parts of New England and the Mid-Atlantic. Great Lakes rain turns to snow over Michigan's western Upper Peninsula Thursday night, high winds continue over parts of the Northern Rockies, and Pacific Northwest rain and mountain snow expand south toward the Northern California coast by Saturday evening while the Southern Plains and Gulf Coast see light rain and storms.
